about.title: About
about.heading: About tooli
about.intro: tooli helps students in Tunisia learn with less stress and more confidence.

why.title: Why we built it
why.text: Good help shouldn’t depend on where you live or how late it is. tooli puts an AI tutor, the best partner courses and top professors in one friendly place.

what.title: What you can do
what.text: Ask any question and get a step-by-step answer, follow partner courses with your progress saved, and book private classes with VIP professors.

who.title: Who we are
who.text: A small team of students and teachers from Monastir who wish this existed when we were preparing the bac.

contact.title: Contact

contact.help: Need help with your studies right now?
contact.helpText: The AI tutor answers day and night, step by step.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.intro: Short and honest: what we keep, and why.

demo.title: This is a demo
demo.text: For now tooli runs without a server: your name, settings and progress are saved only in this browser. Clear your browser data and they’re gone.

store.title: What we will store
store.text: Your account (name, email, a securely hashed password), your profile, language, progress, bookings and tutor chats, only to make tooli work for you.

never.title: What we never do
never.text: We never sell your data and never show you ads based on it. You’ll be able to download or delete everything from your settings.
